Privacy by Design

Enough information to match.
Not enough information to cheat.

CampusMatch separates public discovery information from ownership-verification information.

Public

Safe to browse

Public listings use privacy-safe titles and generic information so students can discover relevant reports without exposing sensitive details.

Private

Hidden ownership details

Private identifying details provided with a Found report stay hidden from potential claimants and are used only for secure ownership verification.

Staff

Human-controlled handover

Matching and verification support the decision, but authorized staff complete the final ownership review and item handover.

Why Found reports ask for private details

The finder helps create the verification key.

When reporting a Found item, the finder can provide details such as a hidden mark, attachment or other identifying feature. Those details are kept private and later compared against a claimant's answers.
